from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class EarningsRecord(BaseModel):
    """Earnings metrics extracted from a single financial report document."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company reporting the financials")
    reporting_period: str | None = Field(description="The period covered by the report (e.g. 2024年第一季度)")
    basic_eps: float | None = Field(description="Basic Earnings Per Share value; negative indicates loss")
    diluted_eps: float | None = Field(description="Diluted Earnings Per Share value; negative indicates loss")
    currency_unit: str | None = Field(description="Currency unit of the EPS (e.g. 元/股)")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    earnings_records: list[EarningsRecord]
